focus: City of San Francisco — Financial District, SoMa, Mission Bay, North Beach, Nob Hill, Civic Center, Japantown, Pacific Heights, the Marina, the Castro, Noe Valley, the Mission, the Richmond, the Sunset, West Portal, Lakeshore and Ingleside
intro: This first San Francisco page covers 20 UPS Store locations across the city whose official location and mailbox-services pages list staffed hours and package acceptance from all carriers — from the Financial District, SoMa and Mission Bay to the Marina, the Richmond, the Sunset, Noe Valley and Ingleside. Three stores say on their own pages that mailbox holders can get 24-hour access: 1410 Franklin St, and 1225 4th St and 3145 Geary Blvd for an additional fee. 14 of the 20 publish Sunday hours, and 4 stay open until 7:00 PM or later on weekdays. Only the 3145 Geary Blvd store publishes mailbox prices. It is not a complete inventory: two more UPS Stores (268 Bush St and 660 4th St), independent pack-and-ship stores, USPS Premium PO Boxes, and Oakland or Daly City storefronts are not covered yet. Box availability can change; treat it as something to confirm. If you cannot get to a storefront, compare virtual mailbox services.

listings.name: The UPS Store — 1410 Franklin St
listings.area: Cathedral Hill / Van Ness corridor · Franklin St (94109)

hours.notes: Staffed store hours from the official location page’s opening-hours data. Holiday hours can differ; the page lists Thanksgiving Day (November 26) and Christmas Day as closed and 3:00 PM closing on December 24.

listings.carriersNotes: The official mailbox-services page for this store says mailbox customers get package acceptance from all carriers, plus mail holding and forwarding. It does not list carrier names. Confirm any size or signing limits with the store.
listings.visitNotes: The store’s mailbox-services FAQ says: “Yes, this location provides 24 hour access to your mailbox,” and to ask about signing up for night lobby access during off hours; some packages can be picked up off hours when prearranged. Box availability is not published as live inventory. Confirm with the store that a box is actually open.

listings.feeNotes: Mailbox prices as listed on 2026-11-27 on the official mailbox-services page. Personal: small $99 (3 months), $186 (6 months), $336 (12 months); medium $135 / $252 / $468; large $165 / $294 / $528. Business: medium $153 / $288 / $540; large $207 / $336 / $600 (3 / 6 / 12 months). 24-hour access is an additional fee; the amount is not published.
